summary: Use the earliest explicit supported body heading for primary RFI/Submittal routing when no explicit workflow Subject exists.
decision_refs: Active user goal to continue improving accuracy and adaptability across RFI, Submittal and Email content
Confirmed synthetic reproduction where an earlier Submittal body heading was incorrectly overridden by a later RFI heading
approval_evidence: The active user goal explicitly includes continued RFI, Submittal and Email accuracy improvements.
known_limitations: Only explicit supported digit-bearing workflow headings participate; semantic references remain human review work.
An explicit workflow Subject still outranks body order, and filename remains the final routing fallback.
Validation is synthetic and offline; no mailbox, model, external provider or customer file was used.
